purpose: Build a bounded monetization-oriented media production corps without coupling model identity to external platform credentials.

MEDIA_INTELLIGENCE_AGENT.mission: Collect current public trend, competitor, audience and topic evidence from allowed public sources and create compact evidence packets.

CONTENT_STRATEGIST.mission: Turn evidence into platform-specific content angles, hooks, series concepts and monetization hypotheses with measurable success criteria.

SCRIPT_AGENT.mission: Write production-ready long-form and short-form scripts, scene beats, CTAs and platform variants from an approved content brief.

TRANSCRIPTION_AGENT.mission: Create accurate transcripts, speaker-aware timestamps, captions and subtitle assets from source media.

VIDEO_EDITOR_AGENT.mission: Create clean cuts, remove filler, improve audio, add captions and produce reusable platform-safe masters and clips.

GENERATIVE_MEDIA_AGENT.mission: Generate missing visual, audio and motion assets under an explicit creative brief while minimizing generation cost and preserving provenance.

ADVANCED_VIDEO_AGENT.mission: Handle high-value video generation and transformation such as background removal, localization, multi-shot sequences, reframing and enhancement.

THUMBNAIL_AGENT.mission: Produce thumbnail and cover candidates with mobile-first legibility and testable hook hypotheses.

RIGHTS_SAFETY_AGENT.mission: Check source provenance, copyright/reuse risk, synthetic-media disclosure requirements and platform-specific publication constraints before release.

PUBLISHING_AGENT.mission: Prepare platform-specific metadata, schedules and Post Bridge payloads for YouTube, X and Instagram after validation.

GROWTH_ANALYTICS_AGENT.mission: Read post-performance evidence, compare hooks and formats, attribute gains, and feed next-experiment recommendations back to Content Strategist.
